messages:
anna: Heads-up: RC build is queued for release/1.12. We need branch alignment and a final changelog owner.

kai: I can own the changelog. Confirming the version bump — should we cut 1.12.0-rc2?

anna: Yes, bump to 1.12.0-rc2. Also callouts: two cherry-picks (#5123, #5199) still pending. We need CI green and a short risk note for any late merges.

sophie: I picked and pushed #5123 to release/1.12, CI passed locally. Pushed branch `cherry/5123-compat-fix`.

ajay: I still need a quick review on the serialization tweak in #5199 — leaving a note for @nick to review.

nick: Reviewing now, will approve within the hour. If serialization change causes regressions we should prefer a toggle or revert and ship rc2 without it.

deploy-bot: AUTO: Preflight CI started for release/1.12 (pipeline 4789). Logs: https://ci.redwood.example/4789 — tests: unit/integration/e2e.

anna: Quick policy reminder: request any late-merge exceptions here with PR link + short justification. We will allow docs/changelog-only patches for +15m post-cutoff, everything else needs explicit approval.

kai: @sophie can you add the changelog entry under Unreleased -> 1.12.0-rc2 and include a migration note about the serializer toggle?

sophie: On it. Adding changelog snippet and a rollback helper in the PR description. Snippet:
```
# rollback if release CI fails
git checkout release/1.12
git revert -m 1 <merge_commit_hash>
git push origin release/1.12
```

ajay: For the exception queue I'm compiling a one-line table: PR | owner | risk | reason. Will post in 5m.

nick: :thumbsup: thanks. Also flagging flaky test `storage/kv_shard_test` — if it flakes we should rerun rather than block.

anna: Final reminder: code freeze in 20m. If you need a late merge, drop PR link + impact + mitigation and tag @anna @kai. After freeze we'll accept only docs/changelog quick patches.

kai: :clock1: noted, I'll monitor CI and signal rollback if tests start failing.
